## This week

The greedy loop commits to one action per turn and never backtracks; on multi-step questions it advances confidently down wrong paths. The remedies: task decomposition and the plan–execute–replan skeleton; ReWOO's separation of planning from observation (quadratic cost made linear); and Tree of Thoughts — candidate states, self-evaluation, BFS/DFS with backtracking. The week before the midterm assembles the whole first half into one system.

## Lab

`W7_lab_research_agent.ipynb` — the first half as one machine: a decomposition planner routes steps to specialist sub-agents (research with tools, writer, editor closing the reflection cycle), and the final report is scored by checklist and LLM judge (≥ 4/5). From Andrew Ng's *Agentic AI* final project.

Homework: `W7_hw_own_topic.ipynb` — the workflow run on a topic from your own research interests, with two self-designed checks added to the checklist. Due before the Week 8 midterm.

Run it in Colab: click **Open in Colab** (links above), paste your API key into the setup cell ([API Setup](api-setup.qmd)), and run top to bottom.
